If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, apply no correction for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment spikes to positive after a downward trend, shift forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% in mid horizon.  
If sentiment turns negative after a peak, reduce forecast by 1–3% in late horizon, especially if true outcome dips below 10% of forecast.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, cap forecast increase at 2% in early horizon to avoid overfitting.
